open_in_inventory.config.refresh: Refresh config in-game using `/open-in-inventory refresh` command
open_in_inventory.config.enabled_items:
format: ItemID, or { id: ItemID, count?: integer, components?: ComponentMap, sneak?: boolean }, ? means optional
ItemID is a string, for example `example_mod:bag`. You can use template to support multiple items at once, for example `example:{color}_bag`
Use `/open-in-inventory replaceTemplate ...` command to view valid templates
open_in_inventory.config.open_delay: delay (in tick) from swapping item to main hand to use such item
open_in_inventory.config.require_single_: Prevent open-in-inventory from applying to item stacks containing more than one item
open_in_inventory.config.require_empty_m: Disable open-in-inventory when player is holding something in main hand
open_in_inventory.config.screen_blacklis: Class name of screen in which this mod will be disabled
